description_en: Obtains the information about a single synchronization job
description_zh: 获取单个同步任务详情信息
name: GetSynchronizationJob

parameters.help_en: The ID of the synchronization job
parameters.name: synchronization_job_id

SynchronizationJob.description_en: The information about the synchronization job

Direction.description_en:
The direction of the synchronization job. Valid values:

ingress

egress
Direction.description_zh:
同步任务方向，取值可选范围：

ingress：入方向

egress：出方向

EndTime.description_en: The end time of the synchronization. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
EndTime.description_zh: 同步结束时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒

Result.description_en: The result of the synchronization job

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code corresponding to the error message

ErrorMessage.description_en: The error message returned in the case of an error
ErrorMessage.description_zh: 同步结果错误信息描述
ErrorMessage.title_en: 同步结果错误信息描述
ErrorMessage.title_zh: 同步结果错误信息描述

GroupMemberStatistics.description_en: The group member synchronization result statistics

Same.description_en: The result statistics about identical group members
The result statistics about identical groups
The result statistics about identical organizations
The result statistics about identical users

StartTime.description_en: The start time of the synchronization. This value is a UNIX timestamp representing the number of milliseconds that have elapsed since January 1, 1970, 00:00:00 UTC
StartTime.description_zh: 同步开始时间，Unix时间戳格式，单位为毫秒

Status.description_en:
The status of the synchronization job. Valid values:

pending

running

failed

partial_success

success
Status.description_zh:
同步任务状态，取值可选范围：

pending：初始状态

running：运行中

failed：失败

partial_success：部分成功

success：成功

SynchronizationJobId.description_en: The ID of the synchronization job

TargetId.description_en: The ID of the synchronization destination

TargetType.description_en:
The type of the synchronization destination. Valid values:

identity_provider

application
TargetType.description_zh:
同步目标类型，取值可选范围：

identity_provider：身份提供方

application：应用

TriggerType.description_en:
The trigger type of the synchronization. Valid values:

auto

manual
TriggerType.description_zh:
同步触发类型，取值可选范围：

auto：自动触发

manual：手动触发
